arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَحَصِّنْ ثُغُورَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِعِزَّتِكَ، وَأَيِّدْ حُمَاتَهَا بِقُوَّتِكَ، وَأَسْبغَ عَطَايَاهُمْ مِنْ جِدَتِكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa ḥassina thughūra al-muslimīna biʿizzatika wa ayyid ḥumātahā bi quwwatik wa-ʾasbaġa ʿaṭāyāhum min jidatika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, fortify the frontiers of the Muslims through Thy might, support their defenders through Thy strength, and lavish upon them gifts through Thy wealth!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَكَثِّرْ عِدَّتَهُمْ، وَاشْحَذْ أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ، وَاحْرُسْ حَوْزَتَهُمْ، وَامْنَعْ حَوْمَتَهُمْ، وَأَلِّفْ جَمْعَهُمْ، وَدَبِّرْ أَمْرَهُمْ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa kaththir ʿiddatahum, wa ashhaẓ asliḥatahum wa aḥrus ḥawzatahum, wa amnaʿ ḥawmatahum wa allif jamʿahum, wa dabbir amrahum
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, increase their number, hone their weapons, guard their territory, defend their midst, unite their throng, arrange their affair,

arabic_text: وَوَاتِرْ بَيْنَ مِيَرِهِمْ، وَتَوَحَّدْ بِكِفَايَةِ مَؤَنِهِمْ، وَاعْضُدْهُمْ بِالنَّصْرِ، وَأَعْنِهُمْ بِالصَّبْرِ، وَالْطُفْ لَهُمْ فِي الْمَكْرِ.
transliteration: wa wātir bayna miyarihīm, wa tawwaḥad bi-kiyfāyat maʾnihil waʿḍudhum bil-naṣri, waʾaʿnihum bi-ṣ-ṣabr wal-ṭuf lahū fī al-makr
english_text: send them supplies in a steady string, undertake Thyself to suffice them with provisions, support them with victory, help them with patience, and give them subtlety in guile!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَعَرِّفْهُمْ مَا يَجْهَلُونَ، وَعَلِّمْهُمْ مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، وَبَصِّرْهُمْ مَا لاَ يُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waʿarrihim ma yajhalun wa ʿallimhum mā lā yaʿlamūn wa baṣṣirhum mā lā yubṣirūn
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, give them the knowledge of that of which they are ignorant, teach them what they do not know, and show them what they do not see!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَنْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ لِقَآئِهِمُ الْعَدُوَّ ذِكْرَ دُنْيَاهُمُ الْخَدَّاعَةِ الْغَرُورِ، وَامْحُ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ خَطَرَاتِ الْمَالِ الْفَتُونِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa'ansihim 'inda liqā'ihimu al-'aduwwa dhikr dunyāhumu al-khaddā'āti al-gharūr wa-amhu ʿan qulūbihim khaṭarāt al-māl al-fatūn
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, make them forget when they meet the enemy to remember this cheating and delusive world of theirs, erase from their hearts the thought of enchanting possessions,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلِ الْجَنَّةَ نَصْبَ أَعْيُنِهِمْ وَلَوِّحْ مِنْهَا لأِبْصَارِهِمْ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ فِيهَا مِنْ مَسَاكِنِ الْخُلْدِ وَمَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ وَالْحُورِ الْحِسَانِ وَالأَنْهَارِ الْمُطَّرِدَةِ بِأَنْوَاعِ الأَشْرِبَـةِ ، وَالأَشْجَارِ الْمُتَدَلِّيَةِ بِصُنُوفِ الثَّمَرِ،
transliteration: wa-ajʿalil jannata nasba ʾaʿyuni-him wa lawwih min-ha li-ʾibṣari-him mā ʾaʿdadta fīhā min masākini al-khuldi wa manāzili al-karāmah wal-ḥūri al-ḥisāni wal-anhāri al-muṭṭaridati bi-anwāi al-ashribah wa al-aš-jāri al-mu-ta-da-lli-ya bi-ṣu-nūfi al-ṯamari
english_text: place the Garden before their eyes, and display to their sight that part of it which Thou hast prepared for them - the homes of everlastingness and mansions of honour, the beautiful houris, the rivers gushing forth with all sorts of drinks, the trees hanging, low with all kinds of fruits -

arabic_text: حَتَّى لاَ يَهُمَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ بِالأدْبَارِ، وَلا يُحَدِّثَ نَفْسَهُ عَنْ قِرْنِهِ بِفِرَار.
transliteration: ḥattá lā yahumma ʾaḥadun minhum bil-ʾadbār walā yuḥaddith nafsahu ʿan qirnih bi-firār
english_text: lest any of them think of turning his back or suggest to himself to flee his opponent!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ افْلُلْ بِذَلِـكَ عَدُوَّهُمْ، وَاقْلِمْ عَنْهُمْ أَظْفَارَهُمْ، وَفَرِّقْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَسْلِحَتِهِمْ ، وَاخْلَعْ وَثَائِقَ أَفْئِدَتِهِمْ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَزْوِدَتِهِمْ، وَحَيِّرْهُمْ فِي سُبُلِهِمْ، وَضَلِّلْهُمْ عَنْ وَجْهِهِمْ،
transliteration: allāhumma aflul bi dhālika ʿaduwwahum wa-aqlim 'anhum 'adhfarahum, wa-farriq baynahum wa-bayna 'aslihatihim wa-ukhlaʿ wa-tha'iq afa'idatihim, wa-baa'id baynahum wa-bayna azwidatihim wa hayyirhum fi subulihim, wa dallilhum 'an wajhihim
english_text: O God, defeat their enemy through that, trim their nails from them, separate them from their weapons, pull out the firm ties from their hearts, keep them far away from their stores, bewilder them in their roads, turn them astray from their direction,

arabic_text: وَاقْـطَعْ عَنْهُمُ الْمَدَدَ وَانْقُصْ مِنْهُمُ الْعَدَدَ، وَامْلاْ أَفْئِدَتَهُمُ الرُّعْبَ، وَاقْبِضْ أَيْـدِيَهُمْ عَنِ البَسْطِ، وَاخْـزِمْ أَلْسِنَتَهُمْ عَنِ النُّطْقِ، وَشَرِّدْ بهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ، وَنَكِّلْ بِهِمْ مَنْ وَرَاءَهُمْ،
transliteration: waqṭaʿ ʿanhum al-madad, wa-nqus minhum al-ʿadad wa-amla af'idatuhumu ar-ru'ba, wa-aqbith aydiyahum 'ani al-basṭi waakhzim alsinatahum ʿani annutq wa sharid bihim man khalfahum, wa nakil bihim man wara'ahum
english_text: cut off reinforcements from them, chop them down in numbers, fill their hearts with terror, hold back their hands from stretching forth, tie back their tongues from speaking, "scatter by them the ones behind them" (8:57), make them a lesson for those beyond them,

arabic_text: وَاقْـطَعْ بِخِزْيِهِمْ أَطْمَـاعَ مَنْ بَعْدَهُمْ.
transliteration: waqt'a bi khizyihim atma'a man ba'dahum
english_text: and through their degradation cut off the hopes of those who come after them!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ عَقِّمْ أَرْحَامَ نِسَائِهِمْ، وَيَبِّسْ أَصْلاَبَ رِجَالِهِمْ، وَاقْطَعْ نَسْلَ دَوَابِّهِمْ وَأَنْعَامِهِمْ، لاَ تَأذَنْ لِسَمَائِهِمْ فِي قَطْر وَلاَ لارْضِهِمْ فِي نَبَات.
transliteration: allāhumma ʿaqqim arḥāma nisāʾihim wayabbis ʾaslāba rijālihim waqtʿ nasla dawābbihim waʾanʿāmihim lā taʾdhann lisamāʾihim fī qatrin walā liarḍihim fī nabāt
english_text: O God, make the wombs of their women barren dry up the loins of their men, cut off the breeding of their mounts and their cattle, and permit not their sky to rain or their earth to grow!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَقَوِّ بِذَلِكَ مِحَالَّ أَهْلِ الإسْلاَمِ ، وَحَصِّنْ بِهِ دِيَارَهُمْ ، وَثَمِّرْ بِـهِ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ، وَفَرِّغْهُمْ عَنْ مُحَارَبَتِهِمْ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَعَنْ مُنَابَذَتِهِمْ للْخَلْوَةِ بِكَ، حَتَّى لا يُعْبَدَ فِي بِقَاعِ الارْضِ غَيْرُكَ
transliteration: allāhumma waqawwī bi dhālika miḥāll ahl al-islām waḥassin bihi diyārahum, wathammir bihi amwālahum wa farrighhum ʿan muḥārābatihim liʿibādatika wa ʿan munābadhazatihim lil-khalwati bika ḥattá lā yuʿbada fī biqāʿi al-arḍi ghayruka
english_text: O God, through that strengthen the prowess of the People of Islam, fortify their cities, increase their properties, give them ease from their fighting to worship Thee and from their warfare to be alone with Thee, so that none will be worshipped in the regions of the earth but Thee

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُعَفَّرَ لاَِحَد مِنْهُمْ جَبْهَةٌ دُونَكَ.
transliteration: walā tuʿaffar laʾaḥad minhum jabhatun dūnaka
english_text: and no forehead of theirs may be rubbed in dust for less than Thee!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اغزُ بِكُلِّ نَـاحِيَـة مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى مَنْ بِـإزَائِهِمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ighz bi kulli nāḥiyatin min al-muslimīn ʿalā man biʾizāʾihim min al-mushrikīn
english_text: O God, send out the Muslims of every region on raids against the idolaters who face them!

arabic_text: وَأَمْدِدْهُمْ بِمَلائِكَة مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُرْدِفِينَ حَتَّى يَكْشِفُـوهُمْ إلَى مُنْقَطَعِ التُّـرابِ قَتْـلاً فِي أَرْضِكَ وَأَسْراً أَوْ يُقِرُّوا بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الَّذِي لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
transliteration: wa-amdidhum bimālaikati min ʿindika murdifīna ḥattá yakshifūhum ʾilá munqaṭaʿi l-turāb qatlān fī ʾarḍika wa-asran aw yuqirru bi-annaka anta allahul-ladhi la ilaha illa anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak
english_text: Reinforce them with angels in ranks from Thee, till the idolaters are routed by them to the end of the land, slain in Thy earth or taken captive, or till they admit that Thou art God, other than whom there is no god, Thou alone, who hast no associate!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذَلِكَ أَعْدَاءَكَ فِي أَقْطَارِ الْبِلاَدِ مِنَ الْهِنْدِ وَالرُّومِ وَالتُّـرْكِ وَالْخَزَرِ وَالْحَبَشِ وَالنُّـوبَةِ وَالـزَّنْج والسَّقَالِبَةِ وَالدَّيَالِمَةِ وَسَائِرِ أُمَمِ الشِّرْكِ الَّذِي تَخْفَى أَسْمَاؤُهُمْ وَصِفاتُهُمْ،
transliteration: allāhumma waʿmum bidhalika aʿdāʾaka fī aqṭāri albilād min al-hind wa al-rūm wa al-turk wa al-khazar wa al-ḥabash wal-nūbatu wa al-zanǧu wa al-saqaalibatu wa al-dayālimah wa sa'iri umami al-shirki allathi takhfā asmā'uhum wa ṣifātuhum
english_text: O God, include in this Thy enemies in the regions of the lands, the Indians, the Byzantines, the Turks, the Khazars, the Abyssinians, the Nubians, the Zanjis, the Slavs, the Daylamites, and the rest of the idol-worshipping nations, those whose names and attributes are concealed,

arabic_text: وَقَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُمْ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَأَشْرَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ.
transliteration: waqad aḥṣaytahum bimaʿrifatika, waʾashrafta ʿalayhim biqudratika
english_text: but whom Thou countest in Thy cognizance and overseest through Thy power!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِالمُشْرِكِينَ عَنْ تَنَاوُلِ أَطْرَافِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَخُذْهُمْ بِـالنَّقْصِ عَنْ تَنَقُّصِهِمْ، وَثَبِّطْهُمْ بِـالْفُـرْقَـةِ عَنِ الاحْتِشَادِ عَلَيْهِمْ.
transliteration: allāhumma ishghalil mushrikīna bil-mushrikīna 'an tanāwuli aṭrāfi al-muslimīn wakhudhum bil-naqṣi ʿan tanaqquṣihim wa thabbith-hum bil-furqati ʿani al-ihtishādi ʿalayhim
english_text: O God, distract the idolaters from reaching for the borders of the Muslims through the idolaters, bar them from cutting them down through being cut down, and hold them back from massing together against them through dissension!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ أَخْلِ قُلُوبَهُمْ مِنَ الأَمَنَـةِ وَأَبْدَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُوَّةِ وَأَذْهِلْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَنِ الاحْتِيَالِ وَأَوْهِنْ أَرْكَانَهُمْ عَنْ مُنَازَلَةِ الرِّجَالِ وَجَبِّنْهُمْ عَنْ مُقَارَعَةِ الأَبْطَالِ،
transliteration: allāhumma akhli qulūbahum min al-amānah wa-abdānahum mina al-qūwah wa-adhhil qulūbahum ʿani al-ihtiyāl wa awhin arkānahum ʿan munāzalati alrijāl wajabbihnahum ʿan muqāraʿati al-abṭāl
english_text: O God, empty their hearts of security and their bodies of strength, distract their hearts from thinking of stratagems, make their limbs too feeble for clashing with men, make them too cowardly for contending with champions,

arabic_text: وَابْعَثْ عَلَيْهِمْ جُنْداً مِنْ مَلاَئِكَتِكَ بِبَأس مِنْ بَأْسِكَ كَفِعْلِكَ يَوْمَ بَدْر تَقْطَعُ بِهِ دَابِرَهُمْ وَتَحْصُدُ بِهِ شَوْكَتَهُمْ، وَتُفَرِّقُ بهِ عَدَدَهُمْ.
transliteration: wa 'ib'ath 'alayhim jundan min malaa'ikatika bi-ba's min ba'sika kafi'luka yawma badr taqtuʿ bihi dābirahum wa taḥsudu bihi shawkatahum wa tufarriqu bihi ʿadadahum
english_text: send against them a troop of Thy angels with some of Thy severity as Thou didst on the Day of Badr, so that through it Thou mayest cut off their roots, harvest their thorns, and disperse their number!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَامْزُجْ مِيَاهَهُمْ بِالْوَبَاءِ وَأطْعِمَتَهُمْ بِالأَدْوَاءِ وَارْمِ بِلاَدَهُمْ بِالْخُسُوفِ وَأَلِـحَّ عَلَيْهَا بِـالْقُذُوفِ وَافْـرَعْهَا بِالْمُحُولِ.
transliteration: allāhumma wamzuj miyāhahum bil-wabā'i wa aṭʿimatahum bil-adwā'ị wa rmi bilādahum bil-khusūfi wa alihhā ʿalayhā bil-quzūfi wa afaʿrahā bil-muhūli
english_text: O God, mix their waters with pestilence and their foods with maladies, hurl down their cities, harass them with peltings, hinder them through drought,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ مِيَرَهُمْ فِي أَحَصِّ أَرْضِكَ وَأَبْعَـدِهَا عَنْهُمْ، وَامْنَـعْ حُصُونَهَا مِنْهُمْ، أَصِبْهُمْ بِالْجُوعِ الْمُقِيمِ وَالسُّقْمِ الالِيمِ.
transliteration: wajʿal miyarahum fi aḥassi arḍika wa abʿadiha ʿanhum wa amnaʿ ḥuṣūnahā minhum, aṣibhum bil-jūʿi al-muqīm wa as-suqmi al-alīm
english_text: place their supplies in the most ill-omened part of Thy earth and the farthest from them, bar them from its fortresses, and strike them with constant hunger and painful illness!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا غَاز غَزَاهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ أَوْ مُجَاهِد جَاهَدَهُمْ مِنْ أَتْبَاعِ سُنَّتِكَ لِيَكُونَ دِينُكَ الاعْلَى وَحِزْبُكَ الأقوَى وَحَظُّكَ الأوْفَى فَلَقِّهِ الْيُسْرَ، وَهَيِّئْ لَهُ الأمْرَ، وَتَوَلَّهُ بِالنُّجْحِ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa-ayyumā ghāz ghazāhum min ahl milatik aw mujāhid jāhadahum min atbāʿi sunnatika liyakūna dīnuka al-aʿlā wa-ḥizbuka al-aqwá wa-ḥaẓẓuka al-ʾawfá fa-laqqihī al-yusra wahayyi' lahu al'amra, wa tawallahu bin-nujh
english_text: O God, if a warrior from the people of Thy creed wars against them or a struggler from the followers of Thy prescriptions struggles against them so that Thy religion may be the highest, Thy party the strongest, and Thy share the fullest, cast ease to him, arrange his affair, attend to him by granting success,

arabic_text: وَتَخَيَّرْ لَهُ الأصْحَابَ، وَاسْتَقْوِ لَهُ الظَّهْرَ، وَأَسْبِغْ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّفَقَةِ وَمَتِّعْهُ بِالنَّشَاطِ، وَأَطْفِ عَنْهُ حَرَارَةَ الشَّوْقِ، وَأَجِرْهُ مِنْ غَمِّ الْوَحْشَةِ، وَأَنْسِهِ ذِكْرَ الاهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَأَثُرْ لَهُ حُسْنَ النِّيَّةِ وَتَوَلَّه بِالْعَافِيَةِ،
transliteration: wa-takhayyar lahu al-aṣḥāba, wa-istaqwi lahu al-ẓẖahra wa'sbigh ʿalayhi fil-nafaqati wa mattiʿhu bin-nashāti wa'aṭfi ʿanhu ḥarārata al-shawqi, wa'ajirhu min ghammi al-waḥshati. wa-ʾansih dhikra al-ʾahl wa-al-waladi wa-ʾathur lahu husna al-niyyati wa-tawallah bi-al-ʿafiyah
english_text: select for him his companions, strengthen his back, lavish upon him livelihood, give him enjoyment of joyous vitality, cool for him the heat of yearning, give him sanctuary from the gloom of loneliness, make him forget the remembrance of wife and child, pass along to him an excellent intention, attend to him with well-being,

arabic_text: وَأَصْحِبْهُ السَّلاَمَةَ، وَأَعْفِهِ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَلْهِمْهُ الْجُرْأَةَ وَارْزُقْهُ الشِّدَّةَ وَأَيِّدْهُ بِالنُّصْرَةِ، وَعَلِّمْهُ السِّيَرَ وَالسُّنَنَ، وَسَدِّدْهُ فِي الْحُكْمِ، وَاعْزِلْ عَنْهُ الرِّياءَ، وخَلِّصْهُ مِنَ السُّمْعَةِ
transliteration: wa'aṣhibhū al-salāmata, wa'aʿfihī min al-jubn wa alhimhu aljura'ata wa rzukhu ashshiddah wa ayyidhu binnusrah wa ʿallimhu al-siyara wa al-sunnan, wa saddidhu fi al-hukm waʿzil ʿanhu al-riyāʾa, wakhalliṣhu mina al-summaʿa
english_text: make safety his companion, release him from cowardice, inspire him with boldness, provide him with strength, support him with help, teach him right conduct and the norms of the Sunna, point him straight in judgement, remove from him hypocrisy, purify him from seeking fame,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ فِكْرَهُ وَذِكْرَهُ وَظَعْنَهُ وَإقَامَتَهُ فِيْكَ وَلَكَ،
transliteration: wa-jʿal fikrahū wa-dhikrahū wa-ẓaʿnahū wa-iqāmatuhū fīka wa-laka
english_text: and make his thinking and remembrance, his departing and his staying, be in Thee and for Thee!

arabic_text: فَإذا صَافَّ عَدُوَّكَ وَعَدُوَّهُ فَقَلِّلْهُمْ فِي عَيْنِهِ وَصَغِّرْ شَأنَهُمْ فِي قَلْبِهِ وَأَدِلْ لَهُ مِنْهُـمْ وَلاَ تُدِلْهُمْ مِنْهُ
transliteration: fa'idha ṣāffā ʿaduwwaka wa ʿaduwwahu faqallilhum fī ʿaynihi wa ṣaġġir shaʾnahu fī qalbihi wa adil lahu minhum wala tudilhum minhu
english_text: When he stands in ranks before Thy enemy and his enemy, make them few in his eye, diminish their importance in his heart, give him a turn to prevail over them, not them a turn to prevail over him!

arabic_text: فَإنْ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَقَضَيْتَ لَهُ بِالشَّهَادَةِ فَبَعْدَ أَنْ يَجْتَاحَ عَدُوَّكَ بِالْقَتْلِ وَبَعْدَ أنْ يَجْهَدَ بِهِمُ الأسْرُ وَبَعْدَ أن تَأمَنَ أطرَافُ المُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: fa-in khatamta lahu bissʿaadati wa qadayta lahu bis-shahaadah fa baʿda anna yajtāḥa ʿaduwwaka bilqatl wa baʿda an yajhada bihimu al-asru wa baʿda an taʾmana aṭrāfu al-muslimīn
english_text: But if Thou sealest him with felicity and decreest for him martyrdom, then let it be after he has exterminated Thy enemies by slaying, captivity has afflicted them, the borders of the Muslims are secure,

arabic_text: وَبَعْدَ أَنْ يُوَلِّيَ عَدُوُّكَ مُدْبِرِينَ.
transliteration: wa baʿda an yuwallya ʿaduwwuka mudbirīn
english_text: and Thy enemy has turned his back in flight!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِم خَلَفَ غَازِياً أَوْ مُرَابِطاً فِي دَارِهِ أَوْ تَعَهَّدَ خَالِفِيْهِ فِيْ غَيْبَتِهِ، أَوْ أَعَانَهُ بِطَائِفَة مِنْ مَالِهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa ayyumā muslim khalafa ghāziyan aw murābiṭan fī dārihi ʾaw taʿahhada khālifīhi fī ghaybatih aw aʿānahu biṭāʾifatin min mālihi
english_text: O God, and if a Muslim should take the place of a warrior or a soldier in his home, attend to those left behind in his absence, help him with a portion of his property,
